objects.name: Shell
objects.description: A spherical carrier with a quiet lattice of glyphs.

objects.name: Torus
objects.description: A ring with an interior: depth on both sides of a continuous surface.

objects.name: Cylinder
objects.description: A cylindrical lattice for wrapping content around a column.

objects.name: Plane
objects.description: A flat carrier for a restrained layer of information.

objects.name: Wave
objects.description: A rippled surface, useful for terrain and soft topology.

objects.name: Signal ring
objects.description: A text band bound to a sphere. Its flow is independent from the carrier.

objects.name: Cubic path
objects.description: Four control points define a free particle trace in three dimensions.

objects.name: Ribbon
objects.description: Three cubic glyph strands follow a gently rippled carrier.

objects.name: Helix
objects.description: Two rising text turns mapped onto one cylindrical carrier.

objects.name: Spiral
objects.description: An expanding planar coil, assembled from eight tangent-continuous cubics.

motions.name: Still
motions.description: Hold geometry and glyphs. Suitable for reduced-motion alternatives.

motions.name: Orbit / Y
motions.description: One full turn per loop around the vertical axis.

motions.name: Roll / Z
motions.description: One full turn per loop in the object plane.

motions.name: Tumble / XY
motions.description: One turn on each of two axes, closing at the loop seam.

motions.name: Float
motions.description: A gentle vertical sine cycle. Combine with rotation or flow.

motions.name: Flow forward
motions.description: Move text on mapped paths, or light pulses on a free cubic trace.

motions.name: Flow backward
motions.description: Reverse the content direction along a ring or cubic path.

motions.name: Matrix flicker
motions.description: Change characters in place, independently from geometry.

motions.name: Character cadence
motions.description: A slower character-change cadence, independent from geometry.

materials.name: Wire
materials.description: Small, subdued crosses for carrier geometry.

materials.name: Signal
materials.description: Readable typography with a mint highlight.

materials.name: Matrix
materials.description: Dense alphanumeric texture. Character motion is a separate choice.

materials.name: Spectrum
materials.description: Color follows the path coordinate, useful for tracing a signal.

behaviors.name: Source shell
behaviors.description: A spherical record array with reversible character overflow.

behaviors.name: Helical index
behaviors.description: Arrange records along the flow framework’s helical organizer.

behaviors.name: Category grid
behaviors.description: Arrange records by their explicit category, without changing that field.

behaviors.name: Hop → pixel sort
behaviors.description: Letters hop to the receiver, reassemble, then commit the record.

behaviors.name: Hop → classify
behaviors.description: Letters travel to a category slot before its grouping handler commits.

behaviors.name: Direct receipt
behaviors.description: A glyph carrier with no receiving delay.

behaviors.name: Geometry weave
behaviors.description: A staggered geometry transition; it creates no transport flight.

behaviors.name: Quick settle
behaviors.description: A brief local transition for small state changes.
